answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake collateral that vests slowly over time, like a pearl forming layer by layer on a terrace of proven work. New identities start at the bottom with tiny limits, and only sustained honest behavior raises their ceiling toward the zenith of full trust. An attacker spawning thousands of fresh identities gains nothing, because each one must pay the same slow, costly climb before it can move real value.
